lifestage.quote: For adult cats aged 1 year and older

health-feature.quote: Omega 3 + Omega 6 for healthy skin and shiny coat

texts.about_this_item: Club 4 Paws Premium "With Veal" complete dry food for adult cats aged from 1 year. 32/15 balanced formula (32% protein, 15% fat) for daily feeding, made with 100% quality animal protein. Omega 3 + Omega 6 support healthy skin and a shiny coat; vitamins D3, E, B1, B5, microelements and amino acids; a mixture of tocopherols as a natural antioxidant. INTEGRAMIX formula of dried tomatoes, ginger, hawthorn and bananas for overall pet health. No artificial flavours or colours.
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding guide by adult cat weight is printed on the pack (kibble only, or mixed with Club 4 Paws pouches). Always provide fresh drinking water.
